connectionFields.obtainedHow: Operator-chosen label in Entro; not a secret.

connectionFields.name: Environment Type
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Select Production, Development, or the matching environment type in the form.

connectionFields.name: API Token
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Buildkite API access token with Entro's documented read scopes; store in the operator vault.

prepSteps.title: Create a Buildkite API token
prepSteps.instruction: In Buildkite Personal Settings → API Access Tokens, create a token for Entro with organization read scopes and store it in the operator vault.
prepSteps.evidence: Buildkite lists an API token named for Entro (value stored outside the session)

uncataloged.evidence: Buildkite lists an API token named for Entro (value stored outside the session)
